guideFlow.stepPrepare: 1 Enable sensors → 2 Align to a star → 3 Move
guideFlow.stepMove: 3 · Move the telescope toward the target
guideFlow.needStar: Now align to one bright star
guideFlow.sensorHelp: Secure the phone with its top edge pointing along the tube. Enable orientation, then align to a bright star to see movement directions.
guideFlow.starHelp: Center a bright star in the eyepiece and confirm. The guide will show which way to move toward your target.
guideFlow.nearHelp: Sensors have an error margin. Check the star pattern in the finder or eyepiece for the final step.
guideFlow.alignedNext: Aligned! You can start directions now.
guideFlow.secondOptional: A second star is optional. Choose a different direction and altitude for another check.
guideFlow.noStars: No suitable bright alignment stars are up. Check your site and current time, or try again after stars rise.
guideFlow.resetHint: Align again after restarting sensors or moving the phone.
